I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Cards and the win banner now respect reduced motion, including preference changes while the game is open. Normal animations and gameplay pass regression checks.

Build, 140 unit tests, and all 78 browser checks passed. Changed files pass formatting; the full formatting check flags existing issues in 17 untouched files.
